about: The winds' instances (registry/README.md, "The tree"; docs/WIND_TYPES.md, "A type's instances"): each specific instrument of a type a node under it -- its made body, each one measured, each one found with its player's settings, each range of them -- and which of them each use plays (`plays`). Made by registry/import/wind-instances.mjs from render/synthesis/geometry/measured.json and render/synthesis/player-settings/: do not edit them here.
